# Installation Instructions — Nothing Phone 2 (Pong)
# Generated by CI/CD Pipeline

## Prerequisites
- Nothing Phone 2 (Pong, SM8475)
- Bootloader unlocked
- ADB + Fastboot installed
- APatch Manager app installed on device

## Step 1: Verify Device State

```bash
# Confirm slot and bootloader state
fastboot getvar current-slot      # Should show: _b
fastboot getvar unlocked           # Should show: yes
adb shell getprop ro.build.display.id  # Should contain: EvolutionX
```

## Step 2: Ensure SELinux is Enforcing (REQUIRED)

```bash
# Check current state
adb shell getenforce
# Must return: Enforcing
# If Permissive, fix BEFORE flashing:
adb shell su -c 'setenforce 1'
# Make permanent:
echo 'setenforce 1' >> /data/adb/service.sh
```

## Step 3: Extract Boot Image

```bash
# From Evolution X 11.11 ROM (Vanilla variant, 2.54 GB)
cd $WORK_DIR
./payload-dumper-go -o boot/ evolution-x-11.11-pong.zip
# Extracted: boot/boot.img
```

## Step 4: Patch Boot Image with APatch

```bash
# Using APatch Manager app on device:
# 1. Open APatch Manager
# 2. Tap 'Install' -> 'Select boot.img'
# 3. Choose boot/$WORK_DIR/boot.img
# 4. Tap 'Patch' -> Output: magisk_patched_XXXXX.img
```

## Step 5: Flash Patched Boot Image

```bash
# IMPORTANT: Flash to active slot (confirm with fastboot getvar current-slot)
fastboot flash boot_b magisk_patched_XXXXX.img
fastboot --set-active=b
fastboot reboot

# Rollback if needed:
# fastboot flash boot_b stock_boot.img
# fastboot --set-active=a
# fastboot reboot
```

## Step 6: Install Modules (In Order)

```bash
# Copy modules to device
adb push modules/ /sdcard/modules/

# Install in exact order:
adb shell su -c "apd module install /sdcard/modules/ZygiskNext.zip"
adb reboot
adb shell su -c "apd module install /sdcard/modules/TrickyStore.zip"
adb reboot
adb shell su -c "apd module install /sdcard/modules/PIFork.zip"
adb reboot
adb shell su -c "apd module install /sdcard/modules/LSPosed-zygisk.zip"
adb reboot
adb shell su -c "apd module install /sdcard/modules/Droidspaces.zip"
# DO NOT reboot until Droidspaces boots safely
```

## Step 7: Final Validation

```bash
# Verify root
adb shell su -c 'id'
# → uid=0(root)

# Verify SELinux
adb shell getenforce
# → Enforcing

# Verify modules
adb shell su -c 'ls /data/adb/apatch/modules/'

# Verify banking app protection
adb shell su -c "apd hide com.bank.app"
adb shell su -c "apd hide com.google.android.gms"

# Test Play Integrity
adb shell su -c 'getprop ro.tricky.store.fake'
# → true
```

## Verification Commands

| Command | Expected |
|---------|----------|
| fastboot getvar current-slot | _b |
| \`adb shell su -c 'id'\` | uid=0(root) |
| adb shell getenforce | Enforcing |
| cat /data/adb/apatch/version | 11219 |
| getprop sys.zygisk.next | true |
| getprop ro.tricky.store.fake | true |

## Rollback

```bash
# Rollback to slot _a
fastboot --set-active=a
fastboot reboot
```
